hints: is_even: the arithmetic command (( $1 % 2 == 0 )) already exits with 0 when true. It can be the whole body.
max: compare with (( $1 > $2 )) and echo the winner.
repeat: build the text in a local variable inside a for (( i = 0; i < n; i++ )) loop, then echo it once.
